# PropFXLab

> Independent prop firm payout intelligence: model take-home after splits, platform fees and withdrawal costs, then compare who pays faster and safer.

PropFXLab is a comparison and calculator site. We do not hold trader funds and are not a prop firm or broker.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.propfxlab.com/): Live firm ranking and take-home estimates
- [Calculator](https://www.propfxlab.com/calculator): Take-home payout calculator
- [Compare](https://www.propfxlab.com/compare): Head-to-head firm matchups
- [FAQ](https://www.propfxlab.com/faq): How rankings, safety status and promo codes work
- [About & methodology](https://www.propfxlab.com/about): Who we are, how take-home math works, data cadence
- [Data audit log](https://www.propfxlab.com/data-audit-log): Sources, update frequency, change-log format, how to verify firm data
- [News](https://www.propfxlab.com/news): Firm and payout updates
- [Boneyard / Defunct](https://www.propfxlab.com/defunct): Closed or high-risk firms

## Data & trust
- Details: [About](https://www.propfxlab.com/about) · [Data audit log](https://www.propfxlab.com/data-audit-log)
- Rules, promo codes and payout channels are scraped then human-reviewed about twice a week (stated on-site as of Sep 2026).
- Safety status uses operating history, regulatory posture, public payout records and community delay reports.
- Contact: contact@propfxlab.com
